email.body:
When feedback arrives in a call transcript, support ticket or review, Autopilot extracts individual feature requests, merges detected duplicates and triages the feedback to the right team.

Canny is customer feedback management software that organizes those requests in one place. Your product team can work from the request itself instead of relying on a link to the full conversation.

Autopilot is included in every Canny plan, including Free.

The Free plan is **$0 per month, billed yearly**, and includes **25 tracked users**—a practical starting point for evaluating AI-powered feedback capture with a relevant source.
